an1.51:1.2: And it is defiled by incoming defilements.
an1.51:1.3: The uninstructed run-of-the-mill person doesn’t discern that as it has come to be,
an1.51:1.4: which is why I tell you that—for the uninstructed run-of-the-mill person—there is no development of the mind.”
an1.52:1.2: And it is freed from incoming defilements.
an1.52:1.3: The well-instructed disciple of the noble ones discerns that as it has come to be,
an1.52:1.4: which is why I tell you that—for the well-instructed disciple of the noble ones—there is development of the mind.”
